name: Douay-Rheims
description: The Douay-Rheims is the classic English Catholic translation of the Latin Vulgate (1582-1610), as revised by Bishop Challoner in the 1750s. It is public domain and approved for Catholic use.

name: Catholic Public Domain Version
description: The Catholic Public Domain Version is a modern translation of the Vulgate by Ronald L. Conte Jr. It is public domain but unofficial: it carries no imprimatur.
